title: Edit the lockfile after the decision record was written (post-record tamper)

prerequisites: A malicious PR author who can run SafeInstall to produce a clean record, then edit the lockfile
attacker.goal: Get a clean-looking decision record committed while the actually-merged lockfile contains something the record never evaluated.

startingState: The PR records an honest install, then silently appends an extra dependency to the lockfile before committing, so the record's 'after' binding no longer matches head.
vulnerableVersion: n/a — defended: the verifier recomputes the head lockfile blob OID and sha256 and requires an exact match with the record
regressionTest: tests/decision-verify.test.ts > fails when the final recorded state does not match the committed head
provenance: RFC-001 §7 A4 defense; adversarial verify suite
